$comment: SineQuiz v1 title list. One entry per title; the per-title arguments are exactly what the two source skills need (.claude/skills/stl-download, .claude/skills/fandom-fetch) so nobody re-discovers them. Run everything with scripts/fetch-sources.sh (see --help). data/ is gitignored: this file is the committed source of truth, data/ is derived from it.

fandom.note: small wiki: ~2.3k chars/episode, pages named 'Episode 1.1'; WARN 'no Season N sections' on character pages is expected

subs.note: country tag disambiguates from the UK original

fandom.note: pass 'The Office', not 'The Office (US)' - the wiki writes it without the suffix

no dedicated fandom wiki (parasite, parasite-film, parasite-2019, parasitemovie all 404). Only shared catalogue wikis exist (movies.fandom.com 'Parasite (2019)', ultimatepopculture, greatestmovies); host=null means fandom is skipped and reported as SKIP, not MISS.
